items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: like when we was with Art Tatum at the Band Box.

ctx.x: Oh, he is another honey. Well, he - that was his debut in the United States. He came from England and he rehearsed his group and we happened to open the same day, at the Birdland, and as always, clean-playing, beautiful sound, good control, his pedal, good taste and everything and we had a tremendous time. We worked together two weeks. One
of the most pleasant two weeks that I ever spent in my life, like when we was with Art Tatum at the Band Box. He was another pleasant person.
George Shearing told me that the first time he heard you and Afro-Cuban jazz, was at the Club Clique and then he decided to record Afro-Cuban music. That's what he told me.
